acceptance.evidence: `src/age.mjs` implements `Number.isInteger(age) && age >= 18`. The frozen `age-boundaries` check completed with exit code 0 and `AC-AGE-PASS`; its assertions cover 17, 18, 19, a string, NaN, infinity, and a fractional age.
`docs/age-notes.md` describes the mechanism and short-circuit behavior, invalid values and effects, absence of external packages, tested boundaries, and maintenance guidance.
